Homemade Spicy Chili
By: Chef Sowmya
Published: Thursday, September 5, 2013 - 9:53am

Ingredients




1/2 cup of minced turkey meat
1/2 can of washed kidney beans, or you can use dried beans, soak it overnight and cook
1 can of diced tomatoes
1 chive finely chopped
1 celery finely chopped
1 carrot chopped finely
1/2 green bell pepper finely chopped
1 teaspoon chili
1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
1/2 teaspoon of basil powder
Salt and pepper to taste
1 tablespoon of vegetable oil

Preparation

1 In a pot, heat oil, add the veggies and cook for 5 minutes at medium heat 2 Add the beans, meat and the tomatoes! 3 Then add the spices, mix well and close the pot for 10 minutes, on simmer. 4 Enjoy it hot with some croutons or crackers!

About

Delicious chili with tons of veggies, meat, beans and spices coming together in a perfect harmony
